title: Te Mataara i te Kūaha Mura
intro: He mano tini puku, whakamataku e tū ana i te paepae whakamataku, e mātaki ana, kāore e whakamātau i te kai, i te inu, i te okioki rānei. He mea hanga mai i tētahi mea kāore i rite ki te paru tangata, e tatari ana rātou ki tētahi kaupapa whakamataku kotahi—ā, kāore anō rātou kia takahi i tētahi whakahau a tō rātou Ariki.
clues: He mea hanga tātou, kāore i rite ki te tangata, he mea hanga mai i tētahi matū e kore e kai, e inu, e ngenge rānei.
E mōhiotia ana tō tātou tokomaha tuturu, ā, e whakakitea ana hoki i roto i te Pukapuka—ehara tātou i te mea e kore e taea te tatau, e kore hoki e te mano tini.
Kāore mātou i tutu ki tō mātou Kaihanga, kāore hoki mātou e kōrero i mua i te whakahaunga.
Kia tae mai te Rā, ka peia mai te hunga whakateka ki a mātou i roto i ngā rōpū, ā, mā mātou e whakatuwhera ngā kūaha mō rātou.
Ka pātai atu mātou ki a rātou: 'Kāore ianei i tae mai ki a koutou ngā karere nō roto i tō koutou ake iwi, hei whakatūpato i a koutou mō tēnei Rā?'
Ka tiakina e mātou tētahi wāhi e kore rawa ai he wairua e puta mai i reira—he rohe mura tonu o te whiu mutungakore.
